from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List, Optional

# Define the output model as per tool configuration
class SearchResultsOutputModel(BaseModel):
    search_results: List[Dict] = Field(default=None, description="List of search results.")
    query_summary: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, description="Response to customer.")
    model_config = Field(default=..., description="ConfigDict extra forbid")

# Retrieve cached results for flights and hotels
departure_flights = get_results_from_cache(key="departure_flights")
return_flights = get_results_from_cache(key="return_flights")
hotels = get_results_from_cache(key="hotels")
attractions = get_results_from_cache(key="attractions")

# Filter departure flights for business class
filtered_departure_flights = filter_flights(
    prior_results=departure_flights,
    flight_class=["business"]
)

# Filter return flights for business class
filtered_return_flights = filter_flights(
    prior_results=return_flights,
    flight_class=["business"]
)

# Search for cultural attractions in Lexington
cultural_attractions = search_attractions(
    city="Lexington",
    type=["Culture"]
)

# Find hotels nearest to the cultural attractions
nearest_hotels = search_nearest(
    hotels=hotels,
    attractions=cultural_attractions,
    groupBy="hotel"
)

# Save the new results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_departure_flights", value=filtered_departure_flights)
save_to_cache(key="filtered_return_flights", value=filtered_return_flights)
save_to_cache(key="cultural_attractions", value=cultural_attractions)
save_to_cache(key="nearest_hotels_to_culture", value=nearest_hotels)
